settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Pick your observation spot on the map by tapping the place name at the top left.
settings.location.why: To compute the eclipse from where you are.
settings.notifications.why: To alert you at each contact of the eclipse.
settings.camera.why: Only for the sun finder; the app works without it.
settings.permissions.hint: Tap a permission to grant it. If you denied it before, your system settings will open.
settings.channel.stableHint: What has been tested. The recommended option.
settings.channel.betaHint: New things sooner, with more chance of bugs. You still get stable releases.
map.safety.title: Never look at the sun without certified glasses
map.safety.body: Only during totality is it safe to look without protection. The app will alert you at the exact start and end.
map.safety.affiliate: Affiliate link: supports the app at no extra cost to you.
settings.drill.startHint: Eclipse mode with C1 in 1 min and the full run in 2 min, with [DRILL] alerts based on yours. Real ones are untouched.
settings.upcoming.note: By default the nearest one is followed{manual}. Each eclipse keeps its own spot and alerts; scheduled notifications are for the active one.
settings.past.note: Picking a past one opens it in archive mode: that day's map, local times and actual cloud cover from any spot, with no alerts.
map.eclipseChip.a11y: Active eclipse: {label}. Opens the list of eclipses from this spot
map.history.title: Eclipses from {place}
map.history.empty: No eclipse visible from here within the computed range.
settings.support.body: Eclipsum is free, ad-free and open source. If it's useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.
settings.aboutNote: Eclipse times are computed on your phone and work offline. Only the cloud forecast and the place search need internet.
tour.map.title: Pick your spot
tour.map.b1: Tap the place name (top left) to search for another spot, or tap any point on the map directly.
tour.map.b2: Drag the bottom sheet up: full timeline, sun height, a heads-up if terrain blocks it, and safety advice.
tour.map.b3: The compass shows where the sun will be; open it and use the camera finder, which you can calibrate against the real sun.
tour.map.b4: The cloud chip opens the Windy forecast for that point at eclipse time.
tour.eclipses.title: Pick your eclipse
tour.eclipses.b1: The Eclipses tab lists upcoming and past events: each eclipse keeps its own spot and alerts.
tour.eclipses.b2: Search by year, date or type to jump straight to any of them.
tour.eclipses.b3: On the map, the date chip shows the eclipses visible from your spot.
tour.alerts.title: Alerts your way
tour.alerts.b1: One switch per contact (C1 to C4): the notification lands at the exact moment.
tour.alerts.b2: Chips add a heads-up {sec} s earlier; on C1, also 1 h and 24 h ahead.
tour.alerts.b3: «Test notification» checks sound and permissions right now.
tour.settings.title: Get ready for the day
tour.settings.b1: Pick the alert sound and review the app permissions.
tour.settings.b2: The drill rehearses eclipse mode and the alerts in a couple of minutes, leaving the real ones untouched.
tour.settings.b3: On eclipse day the app switches to eclipse mode on its own, 30 min before first contact.

sun.title: WHERE TO LOOK
sun.warn.title: Before opening the camera
sun.warn.body:
Never look at the sun without ISO 12312-2 glasses, not even for a moment. And don't point the camera straight at the sun: the lens concentrates the light and can damage the sensor permanently.

This is for finding the right patch of sky and spotting what blocks it. Not for watching the eclipse.
sun.perm.body: Eclipsum needs camera access to draw the sun's position over what you see.
sun.perm.denied: The finder needs camera access. You can grant it in your system settings.
sun.turnTo: The sun will be {dir}, {alt}° above the horizon
sun.below: At that moment the sun is below the horizon from here: you won't see it.
sun.safety: Never with the naked eye · ISO 12312-2
sun.noSensors: This phone has no orientation sensors, so the finder can't work.
sun.calibrate: Compass unreliable: move away from metal and wave the phone in a figure of eight.
sun.below.now: The sun is below the horizon right now: there's nothing to point at.
sun.switchTarget: Switch between the eclipse milestone and the sun right now
